project_name: AI-Based Smart Logistics & Accessibility Intelligence Platform for North Eastern India
emotional_tone: High-tech AI Logistics Command Center (Authoritative, Mission-Critical, Precision, Resilient)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a hackathon-ready Command Center Dashboard for North Eastern India Logistics & Accessibility Intelligence.
Implement Global Status Bar with live system alerts, weather advisories for 8 NE states (Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Sikkim).
Implement Overview Dashboard with NE regional risk grid, live telemetry, and Recharts analytics.

Implement Interactive AI Route Planner with dynamic origin/destination selection across NE hubs (Guwahati, Shillong, Tura, Imphal, Aizawl, Kohima, Itanagar, Gangtok, Silchar, Dibrugarh), cargo type, weight, and vehicle type restrictions.
Implement Route Analysis with side-by-side comparison (Route A Fastest, Route B Safest, Route C Balanced) and AI Overall Score calculation.
Implement Explainable AI 'Why this route?' panel detailing landslide risk index, slope gradient, road quality, and weather factor.
Implement Live Leaflet Map integration displaying routes, terrain, risk heatmaps, and incident markers.
Implement Incident Intelligence & Reporting Modal with instant live rerouting and score recalculation upon reporting landslide/flood/roadblock.
Implement Demo Mode Scenarios with 1-click triggers (e.g. NH-40 Landslide simulation, Monsoon Flash Flood in Barak Valley, Multi-Axle Heavy Truck restriction test).
Ensure ALL interactive elements include `data-testid` attributes for robust automated testing.
universal_guidelines: Dark command center palette with emerald, amber, and red accents.
Generous padding and modern cardless or subtle border aesthetic (max 8px radius or crisp tactical borders).
No transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays.
